summary.intent: Run the GSD UI-phase workflow end-to-end for CipherBox Phase 68 (Web Integration — Rotation UX and Durable Client State) to produce and verify a UI-SPEC.md design contract before planning.
summary.outcome: UI-SPEC.md was generated by gsd-ui-researcher, passed all 6 verification dimensions on the first checker pass (no revision loop needed), and the orchestrator manually set frontmatter status to approved and checked off sign-off boxes before committing.

repo: CipherBox's frontend uses a hand-rolled CSS custom-property design system (terminal/hacker aesthetic: monospace, green-on-black, ASCII glyphs instead of icons) — no shadcn or component registry (components.json) anywhere in the repo.
Existing design tokens: 5-step spacing scale (8/12/16/24/32px), minimal typography scale (11px/14px, weights 400/600), 4-color semantic palette (green/error/warning + black/dark-green surfaces).
Key reusable UI files for notifications/header: NotificationToast.tsx, notification.store.ts (extendable with an optional `action` field), AppHeader.tsx (`.header-right` slot), layout.css, index.css.
workflow: gsd-ui-phase workflow inserts between /gsd-discuss-phase and /gsd-plan-phase, orchestrating gsd-ui-researcher then gsd-ui-checker with a max-2-iteration revision loop.

gsd-ui-checker is read-only — after an APPROVED verdict, the orchestrator (not the checker) must manually update the UI-SPEC.md frontmatter `status: approved` and check off the Checker Sign-Off boxes.
Missing RESEARCH.md/CONTEXT.md are non-blocking prerequisites in this workflow — it proceeds and lets the researcher ask stack/design questions directly instead of halting.

friction: Checker agent's read-only limitation requires an extra manual step (Read + 2 Edits) by the orchestrator to finalize approval status, adding steps not obvious from the checker's own output.
open_items: Phase 68 planning (/gsd-plan-phase 68) is the next step now that UI-SPEC.md is approved and committed.
